message.content:
An editorial illustration for "TEMPO" magazine features a bright blue background. The title "TEMPO" is centered at the top in large black serif lettering, underlined by the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU."

Three caricatured men are depicted from the chest up. On the left, a man in a tan uniform with dark collar tabs looks forward with an intense expression. He holds a large broom made of yellow bundled fibers with both hands. The broom’s handle is brown wood, and its head is wide and fan-shaped. In the center, a smaller man in a light green shirt stands further back, holding his chin with one hand in a thoughtful pose. On the right, a man in a white collared shirt with four stars on his shoulder looks toward the left.

The bottom-left corner contains bold white text: "SEKAM API REFORMASI POLRI," followed by smaller white text about "Listyo Sigit Prabowo." Additional text blocks appear at the top, including "Kalang Kabut Makan Bergizi Gratis H.32" and "Jalan Pintas Anggito Abimanyu H.96." The bottom-right corner displays a date, price, barcode, and QR code.
